topic: SC: counter se kharide railway ticket par bhi online jaisa insurance, 27 Oct 2026 se (Union of India v. Radha Yadav)

slides.title: Counter ticket par bhi **insurance**
slides.subtitle: Ab tak cover sirf online ticket walon ko milta tha. Supreme Court ne kaha: **27 October se** station ki khidki wale ticket par bhi.
slides.cite: **Union of India v. Radha Yadav**, 2026 LiveLaw (SC) 1047 · Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah & Justice R. Mahadevan

slides.label: Masla kya tha
slides.title: Online aur offline mein **bhedbhav**
bullets: Online ticket lene wale thodi si **extra raqam** dekar travel insurance le sakte the.
Lekin station counter se ticket kharidne walon ke paas yeh **vikalp hi nahi** tha.
Amicus curiae ne court ko bataya ki Railways ne is par ab tak **koi kadam nahi** uthaya.

slides.label: Court ne kya kaha
slides.title: Do hafte mein lagu karo
bullets: **27.10.2026 se** sabhi stations par counter se bike har ticket par online ticket ki tarah insurance cover hoga.
Yeh aadesh **mandatory** hai. Paalan na hua toh zimmedari seedhe **Railway Board** ki hogi.
Pehle court ne Railways ko gareeb tabke ke yatriyon ke liye raasta nikalne ka **samay** diya tha, par koi pragati nahi hui.

slides.label: Railways ko phatkar
slides.title: Waade sirf **kaagaz** par
bullets: Court ne kaha ki diye gaye aashwasan zyadatar kaagaz par hi dikhte hain, aur safety ka budget **poora kharch nahi** hua.
Railway Board ke Chairman aur members ko **16 November 2026** ko court mein khud haazir hona hoga.
Zameen par kaam na dikha toh unhe **vyaktigat roop se** zimmedar thehraya ja sakta hai.

slides.label: Dhyan rahe
slides.title: Abhi kya **pata nahi** hai
bullets: Counter ticket ke insurance ka **premium aur cover amount** abhi reports mein nahi bataya gaya. Railways ke notification ka intezaar karein.
Yeh aadesh 27 October se lagu hona hai. Usse pehle ke safar par yeh apne aap lagu nahi hota.
Yeh post sirf jaankari ke liye hai, legal advice nahi.
slides.note: Kanoon ka fact: Train mein durghatna ya **untoward incident** par Railways Act, 1989 ke tahat compensation ka claim alag se hota hai — **Section 124A** (Railway Claims Tribunal).

slides.title: Kanoon samjho, **haq** jaano
lines: Har din ek naya faisla, aasaan bhasha mein.
**Save** karein, aur jo train se safar karte hain unse **share** karein.

caption:
Station ki khidki se ticket lete hain? Yeh khabar aapke liye hai 🚆⚖️

Ab tak railway travel insurance ka vikalp sirf online ticket kharidne walon ko milta tha. Counter se ticket lene wale — jinme bahut se gareeb aur gaon ke yatri hain — is suraksha se bahar the.

Supreme Court ne Railways ko aadesh diya hai ki 27 October 2026 se sabhi stations par counter se bike ticket par bhi online ticket jaisa insurance cover diya jaye. Aadesh mandatory hai, aur paalan na hone par zimmedari seedhe Railway Board ki hogi.

Court ne safety budget poora kharch na hone par naraazgi jatayi aur Railway Board ke Chairman va members ko 16 November ko khud court mein bulaya hai. Premium aur cover amount ki jaankari abhi aani baaki hai — Railways ke notification par nazar rakhein.

Case: Union of India v. Radha Yadav, 2026 LiveLaw (SC) 1047
Bench: Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah & Justice R. Mahadevan
